# Siddhant Vashisth

> Portfolio of Siddhant Vashisth: a business strategist who builds. Final-year B.Tech CSE at JUET Guna (class of 2027), research intern in adversarial ML at IIITDM Jabalpur, Rank 1 of 6,200+ at HackNITR 7.0. Open to BD, business analyst, growth and product roles from Q4 2026.

The site has two faces: a 2D portfolio and a 3D village (the same story, told as a journey). Every fact on both comes from one data file and the résumé.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](/?site=2d): the full site: about, two sides (strategist and builder), battle stats, four flagship projects, internships, awards, photographs, podcast, contact
- [The 3D village](/world): the portfolio as a hidden village at sunset; includes Siddhant's study (his projects and awards as objects in a room) and the residents' quarter, where visitors can claim a house
- [Résumé (PDF)](/resume.pdf)

## Projects

- [Livestock Monitoring System](https://github.com/RISHABH12005/LMS): IoT and AI AgriTech, ~65% cheaper per head; won Rank 1 at HackNITR 7.0
- [ARound You](https://github.com/sidvashisth2005/NEW-CODE-AROUND-YOU): geo-tagged AR memories with ARCore and Vuforia
- [TravelGo](https://github.com/sidvashisth2005/Travelling-App): AI travel planning across 4 APIs
- Superstore marketing consultancy: +25% customer footfall after three recommendations shipped
